text: Guys, this is solid 5 stars. First of all, do not be deceived by the childish look of the app. It is well structured piece of software with decent data model and clear logic. It has lots of features available in free versions. There are some ads, but they are not intrusive, and this is OK, given the free version is really rich in functions. There are some area that require improvement - e.g. I keep getting reminders of habits that I have already completed. I can live with it. Good job people!
